description: Nuqar wears a long warm brown brocade outer robe with broad gold geometric embroidered borders, over an ivory patterned long tunic with richly embroidered neckline and cuffs. A dark brown-and-gold woven sash with several refined circular metal clasps wraps his waist and hangs down the front in tasselled ends. Light tan trouser hems show above dark embroidered leather shoes. His uncovered hands are loosely clasped in front; his head is bare, with no armor or weapons.
